summary: Outline is a team wiki/knowledge-base server (Node/Sequelize/Postgres) with documents, collections, groups/memberships, comments/reactions, shares, integrations, imports/exports, webhooks and OAuth.

_no_edges.why: session signout only, no DB writes, no pre-checks (server/routes/api/auth/index.ts:120)

auth.description: Outline signs in through OAuth / magic links and has no real password column on User. To make the spec usable, sign_in accepts the account email plus a synthetic `password` bridge column on the User seed rows (not part of Outline's real schema). The session it opens carries the User's teamId, which is the tenant boundary every team-scoped tool in this wiki filters on.
